title: Made personal. Never presumed.
intro: Explore the components an official brand supports. Save exact choices for a private request — not a production order or a promise of feasibility.
pending: Waiting for the server. Your previous saved choices are unchanged.
illustration: Illustration only. Colors and proportions are not a physical feasibility assessment.
notApproved: Saved intent · not submitted, quoted or approved
summaryEmpty: Your saved choices will appear here.
empty: No supported options are available for this selection.
noBrands: No onboarded brands currently offer customization.
identityUnavailable: Sign-in and saved choices are temporarily unavailable. You can still browse the brand options.
unavailable: The brand catalog is temporarily unavailable. Nothing has been approved or submitted.
signIn: Sign in to save your choices
signInBody: Browsing is public. Saved configurations and reference images belong only to your account.
stale: The option or configuration changed. Reload before saving again; your last acknowledged selection is preserved.
denied: This action is not available to your account or the selected brand.
invalid: This choice is no longer supported for the selected component, base or caliber.
genericError: This action could not be completed. Your last saved choices are unchanged.
sample: Sample content — illustrative brand options, not a commercial offer
priceNote: Reference only; the brand must issue a current quote.
referenceHelp: Optional: 8-bit, non-interlaced PNG only, under 1 MiB, at most 2048 pixels per side. Save one choice first. No public image URL is created.
referenceSaved: Private reference uploaded; save a dial choice to bind it.
referenceError: The reference was rejected. Use a safe PNG within the stated limits.
referenceUnavailable: The private image is temporarily unavailable. Try loading it again.
needsReview: A newer option revision exists. This saved snapshot is not an approval.
noSelection: Choose a brand, base model and caliber to see supported options.
